sources.label: Wikipedia, "K2-332 b"
sources.quote: K2-332 b is a potentially habitable Super-Earth or Mini-Neptune exoplanet with a radius of 2.2 Earths.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around K2-332. Its orbit and size follow de Leon et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "K2-332 b"
sources.quote: It is in the empirical habitable zone, receiving 1.17 times the light that Earth gets from the sun.
